cell.model: allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Think-SFT served from a path (wsp_edit --recipe interp --other think_sft --alpha 1.0, as in the relay job)
cell.sampling: T 1.0, top-p 1.0, min-p 0; seed 49,000,000 + problem index
cell.cap: 32,768 generated tokens (--max-tokens 32768); the same answers also counted at 16,384

cells.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 2 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe interp --other think_sft --alpha 1.0 --rounding nearest --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label think_sft --prompt cue --set math500 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 49000000 --n 300 --max-tokens 32768 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cells.readout: right answers (v3) at cap 32,768 minus right answers of the same rows counted at 16,384 (rows longer than 16,384 generated tokens count wrong at 16,384), i.e. right answers among rows past 16,384 tokens
cells.why: Think-SFT cue hits the 16,384 cap on about 5 % of MATH-500 (24-25 of 500, result-bf6124), so about 15 of these 300 are cut; f2-m01 says cut samples are unfinished derivations that finish right more often on easy problems than the quarter seen on hard328 (23 of 93, result-c8b994), about half here. run-04/f2-m05 says raw-template cue runs drift (Chinese script, restarts) and drifted continuations are almost never right (1 of 24); an easy problem still running at 16,384 tokens is mostly drift, so it predicts 1-2.

cell.sampling: T 1.0, top-p 1.0, min-p 0; seed 93,000,000 + problem index

cells.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 1.5 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_fresh --model base --prompt plain --set fresh2026 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 93000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cells.readout: right answers with grader v3 (metrics.json right_v3)
cells.why: f2-m02 fixes the cue's share of RL's gain at 55-78 %; on fresh2026 the cued base gets 29.5 and RL 50.5 per sample (result-5251c9), and share = (29.5 - p)/(50.5 - p) >= 0.55 forces the plain base to p <= 4. run-07/f2-m06 says fresh2026's thin middle band compresses every gain, the cue's included, so the plain base sits nearer the cued base than on hard328 (76 of 164 there, ratio 0.46): about half of 29.5.

best_base.note: base + cue, one sample, mean of 4 samples on the same 136 problems (vote over 4 is 38); no other base-only cell exists on fresh2026

cell.model: Olmo-3-1025-7B base + top 8 singular directions per matrix of (Olmo-3.1-7B-RL-Zero-Code - base) at 1.5x (wsp_edit top-k recipe, as in the code-dial cells of result-a1bf75)
cell.sampling: T 1.0, top-p 1.0, min-p 0; seed 61,000,000 + problem index

cells.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 2 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe topk --other rl_code --k 8 --scale 1.5 --rounding stochastic --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label code_top8x1.5 --prompt cue --set math500 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 61000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cells.why: f2-m03 says another reward's top-8 directions at 1.5x give about half of RL's gain over the cued base; the cued base has 410 and RL 463 (result-c36598, result-533123), so 410 + 26 = 436. run-08/f2-m03 says such edits add mostly by turning cap hits into finished answers; the cued base has only 27 cap hits on MATH-500, and converting about two thirds of them at about 45 % right, plus a small precision rise, gives about 420.

cell.set: hard72 (the 72 harder problems in the RL training prompts)
cell.sampling: T 1.0, top-p 1.0, min-p 0; seed 3,700,000 + problem index (new seeds)
cell.samples: 3 new per problem, no restarts; combined with the 4 stored base + cue samples of these problems (studies/rlneurons/results/seen/, attempt 0) for 7 votes

cells.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 2 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model base --prompt cue --set hard72 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 3700000 --samples 3 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cells.readout: right answers of the plurality vote over 7 samples per problem (3 new rows + 4 stored attempt-0 rows; cap hits cast no vote; ties to the lowest sample)
cells.why: The cued base gets 15 of these 72 per sample (20.8 %, result-066c9b), and on hard sets pass@4 is about 1.45 times one sample, about 22. f2-m04 says the vote has removed the slips by 5-7 samples and then sits at the modal-right count, a few below pass@4: about 20. run-04/f2-m01 says the base's wrong answers scatter, so a right answer drawn in only a quarter of samples still wins and each added sample keeps resolving problems: by 7 votes it passes pass@4, about 25.

best_base.note: No base-only count with 7 samples exists on hard72. Scaled: base + cue vote over 4 on hard328 is 192 against 160.5 per sample (ratio 1.20), applied to the 15 per sample on the 72 (result-066c9b), gives about 18

cell.model: allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Think-SFT + 3.0 x (Olmo-3.1-7B-RL-Zero-Math - Olmo-3-1025-7B base), all tensors, bf16 (delta_sum.py)
cell.sampling: T 1.0, top-p 1.0, min-p 0; seed 94,000,000 + problem index

cells.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit l40s --hours 2 -- "bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.delta_sum --host think_sft --donor rl_math --alpha 3.0 --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_fresh --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label tsft_plus_3rl --prompt cue --set fresh2026 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 94000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cells.why: f2-m05 says each unit of RL change finishes more cut samples at lower precision, so right answers peak near 2x. On hard328, a=3 fell to 227 from 231.5 at a=2 (result-3387ce). On fresh2026, where Think-SFT hits the cap on 46 % of samples and the converted problems are hard, a=3 drops below a=2's 69-75. run-05/f2-m05 says the RL push superposes on Think-SFT without disturbing its precision, so more dose converts more of fresh2026's cap hits and right answers keep rising past a=2's 71.

cells.why: f2-m06 carries the hard328 share over to fresh2026. On hard328 the 1x edit closes (192 - 164)/(206 - 164) = 0.67 of the base-to-RL gap (result-284db5); on fresh2026 the cued base gets 29.5 and RL 50.5 per sample (result-5251c9), so 29.5 + 0.67 x 21 = 43.5. run-07/f2-m01 says a finishing edit only converts cut answers, right under 20 % of the time on fresh2026: about 22 of the base's 55 cut problems convert (cap hits fall to 0.6x, as with 77 to 46 on hard328), adding about 4, so about 33.5.
